components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-orange { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 0.875rem; background: #FF6B35; color: #0A2540; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(10 37 64 / 0.2), 0 8px 20px -8px rgb(255 107 53 / 0.6); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-orange:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-orange:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-orange:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #004E89; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 0.875rem; background: transparent; color: #0A2540; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #0A2540; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #0A2540; color: #FFF9F0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #004E89; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Colour Chip
components.description: Matte brand-colour programme card with the age as catalogue code.
components.html:
4 months - 2 years

Infant Care

Gentle care and early stimulation.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 20rem; padding: 1.75rem; border-radius: 1.25rem; background: #FED766; color: #0A2540; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 40px -24px rgb(10 37 64 / 0.45); } .ds-chip-code { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-chip h3 { margin: auto 0 0; padding-top: 2.5rem; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.05; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Link whose orange underline draws in from the left.
components.css: .ds-link { position: relative; padding-block: 0.25rem; color: #0A2540; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 2px; background: #FF6B35; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview: The four brand colours are rationed like a premium paint house. Cream ground, ink-navy text, 1px ruled lines, tall matte colour chips, photos in arched windows. Warm and calm, not loud.
keyCharacteristics: One full-strength colour field per screen.
Orange only for the one primary action.
Ink text on all brand fills.
Flat at rest; one authored hero load plus quiet scroll reveals.

rules.name: The Rationing Rule
rules.body: One full-strength colour field per screen. A second orange button on a screen is a bug.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Fill Rule
rules.body: Text on a brand fill is ink, never white or cream.

dos: Do use one btn-orange per screen, for "Book a tour".
Do set text on brand fills in ink; body copy text-ink/80.
Do build with rules, whitespace and a single colour field rather than boxes.
donts: Don't use emoji or icon-in-circle decoration.
Don't use gradients or rainbow cards; blur is for the nav only.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't build grids of identical icon cards; vary scale, offset and fill.
